subject.title: [Bug]: Discord multi-segment responses arrive out of order when interleaved with tool calls

question: Should blockStreaming=false tool-interleaved text be sent immediately from the shared auto-reply path, kept final-only, or solved by a different suppression/coalescing policy?
rationale: Current source and docs treat no block streaming as final-only, while the issue shows that contract breaks Discord reading order during tool-interleaved turns; choosing the fix changes cross-channel delivery semantics.

options.title: Approve shared direct-send repair
options.body: Review or replace the linked PR so text-only blocks are delivered before tool outputs in shared streaming-off tool-interleaved turns, with dedupe safeguards and live channel proof.

options.title: Keep final-only default
options.body: Preserve the documented blockStreaming=false contract and solve this through an explicit opt-in, coalescing mode, or channel-specific default decision instead.

options.title: Split policy issues
options.body: Keep this issue focused on ordering while tracking suppression/coalescing direction in the related open issues before changing shared behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve shared direct-send repair
recommendation.body: Review or replace the linked PR so text-only blocks are delivered before tool outputs in shared streaming-off tool-interleaved turns, with dedupe safeguards and live channel proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Marcus recently changed the adjacent final-payload media/text dedupe path that the linked repair must coordinate with, and prior review context selected him as the likely decision owner.
